title: How to Find If a COMPANY Is Right For YOU?
description:
It’s obvious to say you want a job that matches your skills but how much have you thought about the culture side of things? LinkedIn recently added new “Commitments” as search filters so now you can search for jobs and will only find companies that match those values. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
